mapper.select: SELECT sk.keyword_id AS keywordId, SUM(ss.score) AS totalScore FROM song_score_tbl ss JOIN song_keyword_tbl sk ON ss.song_id = sk.song_id WHERE ss.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY sk.keyword_id ORDER BY totalScore DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.song_id AS songId, ar.name AS artistName, s.title AS songTitle, al.cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl FROM songs_tbl s JOIN artists_tbl ar ON s.artist_id = ar.artist_id JOIN albums_tbl al ON s.album_id = al.album_id ORDER BY s.song_id DESC
